summary: Preserved pending edits while browsing and applying parameters.
details: Version 1.21.1 preserves valid and invalid pending parameter inputs while browsing effect cards, after applying another parameter and across an unchanged amplifier refresh. Hidden pending inputs retain conflict/recall/effect-power guards. New presets, imports and changed refresh snapshots initialize fresh controls. Focused offline checks cover all 18 controls and five viewport sizes. Actual Windows navigation, Threshold/Gain Apply-and-restore and unchanged full refresh pass, with complete original state/detail independently restored. Nothing saved; Phase 6 remains excluded. Read-only model-browser investigation records partial labels and ordinal distinctions without enabling model writes; full original payloads independently unchanged. Historical Plan range wording is clarified.

summary: Added sliders for all supported effect parameters.
details: Version 1.21.0 adds integer sliders for all 18 supported parameters, synchronized with numeric entry. Sliders set pending values; only Apply writes to the amp. Keyboard increments, accessible labels and existing busy/firmware/offline/bypass guards are preserved. Focused offline WPF interactions cover every integer target and five viewport sizes. All 18 actual Windows slider/Apply paths pass one-step changes and immediate restoration; a fresh independent session verifies the complete original preset. Nothing saved; Phase 6 remains excluded.

summary: Expanded Analog Delay to its observed mobile ranges.
details: Version 1.20.0 expands Analog Delay Level/Feedback to observed 0–100 ranges and Time to 40–2500 ms, including four-digit entry. Exact ADB endpoint frames, 43 affected protocol/save-guard cases and offline pending/busy/firmware/import/five-size checks pass. Actual Windows controls verify boundaries, interior values and representative combinations; high Feedback is tested with Level muted. Complete original state/detail independently restored. Nothing saved; Phase 6 remains excluded. See Analog-Delay-Ranges.md.

summary: Expanded Hall Reverb to its observed mobile parameter ranges.
details: Version 1.19.0 expands Hall Reverb Pre Delay to observed 0–200 ms and Level, Decay and Tone to 0–100 on the verified V1.1.9 profile. Exact ADB endpoint captures and full independent phone restoration are verified. Fifty-five affected Reverb/save-guard cases and offline input/pending/busy/firmware/import/five-size checks pass. Actual desktop handlers verify boundary/interior values and all 16 extreme combinations, followed by complete independent original restoration. No saving; persistence restrictions and Phase 6 exclusion remain unchanged. See Hall-Reverb-Ranges.md.

summary: Expanded all six PLX 100 controls to 0–100.
details: Version 1.18.0 expands PLX 100 Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble, Presence and Master to observed mobile 0–100 ranges on the verified V1.1.9 profile. Exact ADB endpoint captures and complete independent original restoration are verified. Ninety-five affected Amp/save-guard protocol cases pass, including every target and all 64 extreme source combinations in software. Actual desktop handlers verify boundary/interior values for all six controls and all-minimum/all-maximum/alternating combinations, restoring every original byte independently. Offline input/pending/busy/firmware/import/five-size checks pass. No saving; persistence restrictions and Phase 6 exclusion remain unchanged. See PLX100-Ranges.md.

summary: Expanded OD808 Gain, Tone and Volume to 0–100.
details: Version 1.17.0 expands OD808 Gain, Tone and Volume to the mobile app’s observed 0–100 ranges on the verified V1.1.9 profile. ADB endpoint captures and full independent original restoration are verified. Forty-two focused protocol/save-guard cases pass, covering every target and representative combined source profiles. Actual desktop handlers verify boundaries/interior values and all eight extreme combinations, followed by complete independent restoration. Offline input/pending/busy/firmware/import/five-size checks pass. Typing pending Tone now immediately refreshes the effect on/off button and related controls. No saving; existing persistence restrictions and Phase 6 exclusion remain unchanged. See OD808-Ranges.md.

summary: Expanded Noise Killer Threshold and Level to 0–100.
details: Version 1.16.0 expands Noise Killer Threshold and Level to the mobile app’s observed 0–100 range on the verified V1.1.9 profile. ADB endpoint commands and complete original restoration are independently verified. Thirty-eight focused protocol/save-guard cases pass, including software encoding checks across all 10,201 integer source combinations. Actual desktop handlers verified 0, 1, 25, 50, 75, 99 and 100, all four extreme combinations and full independent restoration. Offline input/pending/busy/firmware/import/layout checks pass. Nothing saved; same-slot saving remains limited to original 0D content with Threshold 25/26. Phase 6 remains excluded. See Noise-Killer-Ranges.md.

summary: Added guarded Hall Reverb editing and resolved Tone mapping.
details: Version 1.15.0 adds guarded Hall Reverb Pre Delay 18–20 ms, Level 23–24, Decay 34–35 and Tone 0–1. Independent ADB captures resolve Tone to word 5 and confirm all four parameter offsets. Forty-eight relevant protocol cases and offline summary/input/state/layout checks pass. Actual Windows handlers tested each control, the 19 ms midpoint and all four together; a fresh independent connection matched every original state/detail byte. No saving. USB stay-awake remains enabled during ongoing development/testing. Phase 6 remains excluded. See Reverb-Editing.md.

summary: Added guarded Analog Delay parameter editing.
details: Version 1.14.0 adds guarded Analog Delay Level 16–17, Feedback 24–25 and Time 499–500 ms. Exact ADB phone commands and full independent restoration are verified. Thirty-eight relevant protocol cases and focused offline UI/layout checks pass. Actual Windows handlers tested each control and their combined dirty state, with every original state/detail byte independently restored. No saving. USB stay-awake remains enabled across ongoing development/testing; Phase 6 remains excluded. See Delay-Editing.md.

summary: Added guarded PLX 100 Gain and Master editing.
details: Version 1.13.0 adds guarded PLX 100 Gain 99–100 and Master 74–75 alongside Bass 34–35, Mid 42–43, Treble 39–40 and Presence 44–45. Exact ADB phone frames and complete independent phone restoration are verified. Sixty relevant protocol tests and focused offline UI guards pass. Actual Windows handlers verified both new controls individually, then all six bounded Amp controls together, restoring every original state/detail byte through an independent connection. Nothing saved. USB stay-awake remains enabled across the ongoing session. Phase 6 remains excluded. See Amp-Gain-Master.md. Additional offline geometry checks confirm all six Amp inputs/actions remain within the horizontal viewport and scrollable content at 1920×1080, 1366×768, 911×512, 683×384 and 620×320 logical pixels. No screenshots or hardware commands were used for those checks; physical DPI/Narrator acceptance remains open.

summary: Added guarded PLX 100 Treble and Presence editing.
details: Version 1.12.0 adds guarded PLX 100 Treble 39–40 and Presence 44–45, including combinations with Bass 34–35 and Mid 42–43. ADB phone changes/restoration and exact captured frames are independently corroborated by full original-state equality. Forty-nine focused protocol tests and offline UI guards pass. Actual Windows handlers restored each new control individually, then verified all four tone controls changed together and completely restored through an independent connection. Nothing saved; no computer screenshots or mobile-screen stability checks. The user clarified USB stay-awake must remain enabled throughout the ongoing testing/development session, including packaging between tests; restore its backed-up original value only when the session finishes or on request. Phase 6 remains excluded. See Amp-Tone-Controls.md.

summary: Added guarded PLX 100 Mid editing.
details: Version 1.11.0 adds guarded PLX 100 Mid Apply at 42–43 on V1.1.9, alongside Bass 34–35. Exact mobile frames, 38 focused protocol cases and offline UI input/busy/firmware/import/pending-edit guards pass. Actual Windows Mid and combined Bass/Mid edits were read back and completely restored; an independent fresh connection matched every original state/detail byte. A separate ADB-operated phone Mid 43→42→43 test also passed with full independent original-state verification. The user authorized ongoing ADB testing, iAMP-only phone screenshots and temporary USB stay-awake with restoration; the original phone setting was restored and verified. No saves or computer screenshots. Do not request further mobile-screen stability checks unless the user asks. Phase 6 remains excluded. Evidence: Amp-Mid-Editing.md and ADB-Testing.md.

summary: Added guarded PLX 100 Bass editing.
details: Version 1.10.0 adds explicit PLX 100 Bass Apply on V1.1.9, limited to 34–35 in the exact observed third-position Amp layout. Every other Amp field is preserved and unfamiliar layouts/values stay disabled. Phone command capture confirms the Bass word and exact frames. Twenty-five focused protocol tests (new Bass cases plus affected existing parameter regressions) and offline input/busy/firmware/import/pending-edit guards pass. Actual Windows Apply 35→34→35 passed, followed by independent complete original state/detail verification. Noise Killer stays enabled in the latest user baseline. No saves, screenshots or phone settings changed; no mobile-screen stability check requested. Phase 6 remains excluded. Evidence and limits are recorded in Amp-Bass-Editing.md.

summary: Added read-only amplifier battery information.
details: Version 1.9.0 adds read-only battery percentage and read time on Amplifier Information. Connect/Refresh reads it on V1.1.9, with an approximately thirty-second refresh while connected. Power-state codes remain opaque; charging labels are not inferred. Local snapshot imports clear battery data. Ten focused protocol cases and offline display/import checks pass. Actual Windows Connect and a due production refresh reported 100%; independent before/after reads matched every original state/detail byte. No edits, recalls, saves, screenshots or phone-setting changes; no mobile stability check requested. Phase 6 remains excluded. Evidence and limitations are recorded in Battery-Information.md.

summary: Added a separate Amplifier Information screen.
details: Version 1.8.0 moves Firmware, Preset Slots, GIR/GNR Slots and Drums/Looper cards to a dedicated Amplifier Information screen. Its sidebar item sits directly below Amplifier Settings, the renamed Amplifier library screen. Information uses the same existing values and snapshot/connection status; navigation sends no amplifier commands and preserves selected presets, snapshots, pending inputs and connection state. Cards adapt to smaller widths. Existing Settings/History/search shortcuts retain their actions. Focused offline checks cover menu order/labels, screen visibility, information cards/status, state preservation and responsive bounds; no full-suite rerun, screenshots or device access. Phase 6 remains excluded.

summary: Simplified disabled effect status text.
details: Version 1.7.3 simplifies disabled effect status to “Disabled”, removing the redundant “bypassed” wording. Enabled status and Enable/Disable controls are unchanged. Focused offline effect UI checks verify exact status text alongside existing icon alignment/color and action guards; no full suite, screenshots or device access.

summary: Centered effect labels beneath their icons.
details: Version 1.7.2 centers all effect category labels beneath their icons, fixing the visibly offset OD label. Unknown-state captions are centered too. Focused offline UI checks compare each label/icon center for all five effects and preserve the existing color/action/offline guards. No full-suite rerun, screenshots or device access; Phase 6 remains excluded.

summary: Removed redundant On/Off text from effect icons.
details: Version 1.7.1 removes redundant On/Off text beneath supported effect icons. Category names and enabled category colors/disabled grey icons remain. The effect details panel retains confirmed status and Enable/Disable controls; unknown models still identify their unknown state. Focused offline UI checks cover all five icon/category labels, absence of On/Off text, grey versus category colors, preserved action labels and offline write blocking. No full-suite rerun, screenshots or device access; Phase 6 remains excluded.

summary: Added effect on/off controls and mobile category icons.
details: Version 1.7.0 adds grey bypassed-effect indicators, matching mobile category icons and Enable/Disable effect controls for the five verified models (Noise Killer, OD808, PLX 100, Analog Delay and Hall Reverb). Thirteen focused protocol tests and offline icon/state/write-guard UI checks passed. Actual Windows handlers toggled and restored each effect individually; final independent readback matched every original state/detail byte. Noise Killer remains disabled; the other four remain enabled. Amp readback also mirrors an observed linked flag, now included in the strict expected-byte check after an initial guard failure and independently verified restoration. Nothing was saved and no tone parameters changed. The user reported phone iAMP stable afterward. Future mobile-screen stability checks must not be requested unless the user asks. No screenshots or phone-setting changes. Phase 6 remains excluded. Evidence and limitations are recorded in Effect-Bypass.md.

summary: Moved the preset dropdown into the section header.
details: Version 1.6.3 places the compact preset dropdown on the same row as the Presets heading/count, between the heading and search. The dropdown is capped at 440 pixels. Search wraps below at smaller widths, and very narrow layouts also wrap the dropdown to keep controls usable. Focused offline checks cover header geometry at window widths 1280, 1050, 800 and 620, dropdown checkmark placement, selected-field contents, filtering, clearing and focus. The full suite was not rerun for this layout-only change. No screenshots or amplifier/phone access; Phase 6 remains excluded.

summary: Refined the preset checkmark and added search clearing.
details: Version 1.6.2 shows the active blue checkmark only inside the open preset dropdown; the selected-item field shows bank/name without a checkmark. Search now has a right-side × button that appears only when text is present, clears the filter and returns focus to the input. Focused offline UI checks cover popup check color/position, absence of a check in the selected field while open/closed, empty/text/whitespace visibility, clearing/restoring all presets, no-match filtering and focus. The full test suite was not rerun for these isolated UI changes. No screenshots, phone or amplifier access, or Phase 6 work.

summary: Replaced the preset table with a compact dropdown.
details: Moved Firmware, Preset Slots, GIR/GNR Slots and Drums/Looper information above Presets. Presets now use a compact dropdown with bank labels and device-reported names. A checkmark in #4385ff appears to the left of the active amplifier preset; other rows reserve the same space for alignment. Choosing a dropdown entry uses the existing guarded recall workflow and unsaved-discard confirmation. Escape cancels browsing and declined or failed recalls restore the displayed active selection. The dropdown is disabled during operations. Search remains available. No amplifier commands or parameter ranges were added, and no Phase 6 work was performed. Validation passed: 137 .NET and five Node tests, zero build warnings/errors, four responsive layout sizes, local snapshot guards, version history preservation and actual offline dropdown popup rendering. Exactly one active checkmark was verified in the left column with color #4385ff. No phone or amplifier access was performed.

summary: Added mobile-style preset banks and automatic current-preset synchronization.
details: Presets now display amplifier labels 0A–0D through 19A–19D with their device-reported names. Scanning a single amplifier or selecting one connects and loads the library/current preset automatically. The connection remains open until Disconnect, with current-preset refresh every three seconds. Connect is disabled without a valid target. Clicking a row or pressing Enter recalls that preset with fresh-state and complete global-state readback checks. Current rows are highlighted, bank labels are searchable and pending inputs are preserved if the amplifier changes externally. Known live unsaved edits and pending input require explicit discard confirmation. Phase 6 remains excluded. See the updated implementation plan, user guide and Preset-Browser evidence document. Hardware validation on V1.1.9 passed all 79 alternative recalls with original 0D restored after each, automatic timer synchronization, pending-input protection and automatic scan/connect. Final independent readback matched every original state/detail byte. The user reconnected phone iAMP and reported a stable normal effects screen; the earlier loop cause remains unresolved. No parameters or saved presets were changed. Unsaved edits require discard confirmation with No as default. All 137 .NET and five Node tests and offline UI regressions pass. Saving remains limited to the previously supported 0D profile.

summary: Fixed Bluetooth cleanup after amplifier power-off.
details: A real power-off test exposed an already-disposed Bluetooth object during session teardown. Cleanup now tolerates expected closed/cancelled native operations, always attempts to release both device resources and ignores callbacks after disposal. Five offline cleanup cases pass. A bounded read-only probe verifies the exact original baseline before power-off and requires a real disconnect notification. The repeat hardware test completed cleanup and blocked a subsequent request without sending another command. After restart, the desktop read and an independent read matched every original state and preset byte, including index 4 and Threshold 25. No parameter edits, preset recalls or saves were sent. Broader Bluetooth-toggle/sleep cases and the original mobile transfer-screen trigger remain unresolved. Documentation scope update: all Phase 6 advanced-function work is deferred unless explicitly instructed by the user.

summary: Prevented interleaving of complete amplifier workflows.
details: Each Windows session now serializes complete current-preset reads, name reads, guarded edits, recalls and saves, including fresh-state checks and readback. Concurrent API requests cannot insert commands between these steps. Cancelling a queued workflow leaves the active workflow alone; active failure or cancellation blocks later workflows until reconnection. Disposal interrupts cooperative work without releasing a still-running action to another caller. Nested internal reads use private core methods to avoid re-entering the queue. Eight new offline cases pass. Concurrent read-only hardware workflows and the actual desktop Read handler completed 12 and six commands with no transfer events; independent reads matched every original state and preset byte. No command formats, supported values or automatic retries were added, and no parameters, recalls or saves were changed during validation. Physical fault and write regression remain separate.

summary: Added reproducible evidence export for read-only connection checks.
details: Added an explicit read-only diagnostic preview command for development verification. It uses the normal amplifier Read handler, then exports bounded diagnostics and the exact displayed snapshot beside a preview image. Existing output paths are refused before connecting. Exported firmware, capture time and complete raw payloads are checked against the display. The actual desktop hardware read passed on V1.1.9: six read-only commands completed, the connection was disposed, no transfer events occurred and independent before/after reads matched all original state and preset bytes. The user subsequently reconnected phone iAMP and reported a stable normal effects screen; no timed passive phone capture was taken. Default startup and existing controls are unchanged; no parameters, preset recall or saves were changed. Broader fault paths and the mobile transfer-screen trigger remain unresolved.

summary: Improved compact layouts and keyboard navigation.
details: The main window can fit smaller desktop work areas. Connection inputs shrink, information cards reflow, and the header/search move to separate rows when space is limited. The sidebar scrolls in short windows, and preset names use the available table width while preserving index alignment. Added Ctrl+1 for Amplifier library, Ctrl+2 for Version History and Ctrl+F for preset search. Buttons have a visible keyboard focus border, and key inputs have accessible names. No hardware actions are bound to these shortcuts. Offline layout checks cover desktop sizes corresponding to common display scaling; full physical DPI and screen-reader acceptance remain open.

summary: Added read-only comparison with local snapshots.
details: Added Compare snapshot beside Open snapshot. Compare the displayed snapshot with a validated local file to see changed preset identity, effect fields, firmware and unmapped state/trailer data. Complete raw payloads are checked, including stored name padding and unknown fields. Comparison preserves the displayed snapshot and pending inputs and never connects to or edits the amplifier. Malformed, tampered or oversized files are rejected. Capture timestamps are intentionally excluded from value differences; matching files do not prove current hardware or saved-preset state.

summary: Added local export of connection diagnostics.
details: Added Export diagnostics in the sidebar. The app keeps the latest 256 connection and command events in memory, including typed outcomes, timestamps and elapsed time. Export writes a local JSON file only when requested. It excludes Bluetooth addresses, device names, preset names and values, raw packets, file paths and exception text. Connection attempts and the production command dispatcher supply the events; timeouts, transfer-state failures and blocked commands are identified. Diagnostics are discarded when the app closes and are never uploaded automatically. Offline privacy, bounded-buffer, concurrency and actual export checks are included. Supported amplifier controls are unchanged; physical lifecycle testing and the mobile transfer-screen trigger remain open.

summary: Unified command lifecycle checks and added simulated transport tests.
details: Reads, saves, recall and live updates now share one serialized command dispatcher. Disconnects, active cancellation, timeouts, disposal, write failures and transfer-status notifications permanently stop the session and prevent queued or later commands from being sent. Replies cannot override a failed write or disconnect; late native failures are observed without replay. Cancelling a request while it is still queued leaves the active request alone. Offline tests exercise the production dispatcher through a simulated transport. No amplifier command formats, supported controls or automatic retries were added. Physical disconnect and reconnect acceptance remains separate, and the mobile transfer-screen trigger is still unresolved.

summary: Reject inconsistent amplifier snapshots before editing.
details: Current-preset reads now require complete matching state replies before and after fetching preset details, rather than comparing only the selected index. Changes to global or unknown state fields during a read reject the snapshot and require a refresh. State responses must match the observed 92-byte structure, and details must identify the same preset. Offline regression tests cover each state byte, preset switches, malformed responses and preservation of unknown fields. No new amplifier commands, automatic retries or supported editing ranges were added. This improves read consistency but does not establish atomic snapshots or resolve the mobile transfer-screen trigger.

summary: Added repeatable Windows build and release checks.
details: Added one Bash command to check semantic version and history consistency, run capture and protocol tests, build with locked dependencies and package the self-contained Windows app into a separate staging folder. Added a GitHub Actions workflow using the same command and retaining the Windows package as a build artifact. These software checks need no phone, amplifier, APK, REA or Python installation. Publishing checks verify that the packaged application version and history match the source. Hardware behavior is unchanged; the mobile transfer-screen trigger remains unresolved.

summary: Stop Windows sessions when the amplifier reports transfer-state changes.
details: Added a defensive check for the status notifications observed during the mobile transfer-screen loop. A notification invalidates the current Windows session, stops pending operations and prevents subsequent commands in that session, even if another status notification follows. Coalesced notifications are checked before accepting a response. No write or save is automatically replayed. Read-only handoff checks through the probe and desktop app, including with USB connected, preserved every original preset and global-state byte without reproducing the loop. The original trigger remains unresolved; this guard does not claim to fix the amplifier or mobile app.

summary: Added a restricted same-slot preset save workflow.
details: Added Save current preset with explicit overwrite confirmation for British Lead Solo at index 4 on firmware V1.1.9. Saving is limited to the original captured configuration with Noise Killer Threshold 25 or 26; all other values and the name must remain unchanged. The app checks a fresh complete snapshot, sends the observed same-slot save request once, recalls the same slot and verifies every value. The approved Windows handler test saved 26, saved original 25 back, and independently verified every original byte after recall. An interrupted or unconfirmed save disables further edits until a fresh read and is never replayed automatically. Local snapshot files cannot enable saving. A mobile transfer-screen loop was observed after testing and cleared by restarting the amplifier with USB unplugged; its cause remains under investigation. Broader saving, renaming and power-cycle persistence remain in development.

summary: Added version history and the current desktop version.
details: Added Version History to the left navigation and displayed the current application version beneath DESKTOP COMPANION. The history page lists versions, local dates and summaries; selecting an entry opens its full details. Returning to Amplifier library preserves the current snapshot, pending inputs and scroll position. Version history is included with the published Windows application. Application build metadata and the sidebar version now use one shared semantic version.
